_comment: PLAY ability on an Action card. LOOK_AT top 1 of own deck (player SELF) into 'looked'. BANISH_REF banishes that card from deck (from_zone 'deck' required per effect_types.py:3780 - otherwise banish leaves card in both zones). CONDITIONAL_EFFECT checks if the banished card was yellow (pitch 2) via REF_PITCH_IS on the same ref (card object persists after banish). If yellow, CREATE_TOKEN runechant. GoAgain is a printed keyword (in printed_keywords) and comes from the card DB, not authored here.
